Staying hydrated is important and not just for us humans, but for our dogs, too. Whether you’re out on a long dog walk or traveling with your pooch to a pet-friendly destination, a dog travel water bottle will allow your best pet pal to regularly quench his thirst. Most dog water bottles feature a dispenser of some sort, which means your dog can drink straight from the bottle so you don’t need to take a bowl around with you. However, if you are going on a long journey, bringing a travel bowl for dog food, in addition to the travel water bottle, might be a good idea.

If you want a simple, yet effective dog travel water bottle, look no further than the Portable Water Bottle for Pets - Perfect for outdoor outing with Pets- Leak Proof & Safe.

The two-piece design features a bowl-style section that easily slides out for you to give your dog a drink from, but stays firmly in place when you want it to. The wide-mouthed opening is easy to fill and pour from and the lid fixes on securely with no leaks.

The 350 ml/12 ounce capacity is fairly generous but not so large that it’s heavy to carry. You might need to find a spot to refill it on a long car journey or an all-day hike, but it’s more than enough for most situations. If you’re concerned about the potentially harmful chemicals in some plastics, you’ll be please to know that the Portable Water Bottle for Pets is completely BPA-free. It’s also dishwasher safe, as long as you don’t put it too near the heating element. With a price tag of just $25, this dog travel water bottle offers exceptional value for money.

The Portable Water Bottle for Pets is sleek, stylish, handy and compact dog travel water bottle as our top pick that does its job with no complaints. And costing just $25, you won’t be out of pocket if you buy one of these for your four-legged friend.

The paw print design on the bottle is cute, for users who’d prefer a more plain-looking option. With a capacity of around 12 ounces, this isn’t the water bottle you’d want to take on a long journey (unless you had the option for regular refills), but the smaller size does make it lighter, even when full, so it won’t weigh you down. Plus, it comes on a handy strap to make it easier to carry. This water bottle has a hinged design with a bowl/dispenser that you can set down for your companion to drink from. The only issue is that the bottle remains attached to the dispenser portion, so you have to hold it out of the way while your dog drinks, otherwise it would just fall back down into the bowl. Despite this slight design flaw, it’s still a great product over all, especially if you don’t want a dog water bottle that’s too large.

Unlike many competitors, which feature a bulky plastic dispenser, the drinking bowl on this water bottle is made from a piece of lightweight silicone that flips out from the main body of the bottle. As long as you secure the lid properly, it’s completely leak-free so you don’t have to worry about drips.

However, it’s especially important that you own one if you regularly take your dog out and about with you for more than a few hours, go on long walks or hikes (especially in warm weather), or bring your dog on lengthy car journeys. You can’t always guarantee that you’ll find a spot where you can stop for water, so it makes sense to be prepared. In addition to our recommendation of buying a travel water bottle for your dog, another must-have travel item for your pet is Portable Pet Carrier Bag Breathable Mesh Pet Travel Backpack - Outdoor Shoulder Bag For Small Dogs Cats to help make carrying your dog on long trips or walks easier.

Its totally water capacity of 12 ounces is plenty to take out on a four or five hour hike (or even longer if you have a small dog or a place to refill) but isn’t so large that it will weigh you down when full. The bottle doesn’t weigh much when empty, either, which makes it lighter when filled than many similar models. The carabiner clip easily attaches to a pack or belt loop, for hands-free carrying and easy access.
